description: exp031 - trade nap for tph at out_proj. Exact clone of exp030 (12 layers, single-stream + Linear head, anchor_pairs init, hard, low tph qk nap4/tph32, v nap6/tph32) with ONE change: out_proj LUT nap7/tph64 -> nap6/tph128 (one fewer address bit, double the tables per head). Note out_proj TABLE params are unchanged (2^7*64 = 2^6*128 = 8192 rows/head); only the hyperplane-addressing params grow slightly. Tests whether more, shallower out_proj tables beat fewer, deeper ones at fixed table budget. Everything else byte-identical to exp030/exp024: seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tok/step, Lion 2e-4 tables / AdamW 3e-4 rest, warmup 1600 cosine, E384/6h x64/ctx512/vocab32768/RoPE1e4. Baselines: exp024 1.2034 (6L full, 276.5M), exp026 1.3735 (6L low-tph, 56.6M), exp030 ~1.3150 (12L low-tph, 88.0M).
